best = i; }\n    }\n    return best;\n}\n\nint extend_tree(std::vector<Node>& tree, int near_idx, const Vec3& tp, const Quat& tq, float d_req, bool allow_slide) {\n    const Vec3 p0 = tree[near_idx].p;\n    const Quat q0 = tree[near_idx].q;\n    float lin = norm(tp - p0);\n    float ang = q_angle(q0, tq);\n    const float max_lin = 0.045f, max_ang = 0.055f;\n    float frac = 1.0f;\n    if (lin > max_lin) frac = std::min(frac, max_lin / lin);\n    if (ang > max_ang) frac = std::min(frac, max_ang / ang);\n\n    Vec3 np = p0 + (tp - p0) * frac;\n    Quat nq = q_slerp(q0, tq, frac);\n\n    if (edge_valid(p0, q0, np, nq, d_req, 3)) {\n        tree.push_back({np, nq, near_idx});\n        return (int)tree.size() - 1;\n    }\n    if (!allow_slide) return -1;\n\n    // Compliant sliding retraction!\n    Vec3 sp = np;\n    Quat sq = nq;\n    if (retract_pose(sp, sq, d_req + 0.004f, 5)) {\n        // Check step size & edge validity from (p0, q0)\n        if (norm(sp - p0) <= 0.07f && q_angle(q0, sq) <= 0.09f) {\n            // Make sure we didn't just bounce straight back onto p0\n            if (pose_dist(p0, q0, sp, sq) > 0.012f && edge_valid(p0, q0, sp, sq, d_req, 4)) {\n                tree.push_back({sp, sq, near_idx});\n                return (int)tree.size() - 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\nint main() {\n    auto t_start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n\n    // 1. cur != -1; cur = tA[cur].parent)\n                            path.push_back({tA[cur].p, tA[cur].q});\n                        std::reverse(path.begin(), path.end());\n                        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(sol_mtx);\n                        printf(\"[Thread %d, d_req=%.3f] DIRECT SEPARATION at iter %d! tA=%zu, len=%zu\\n\",\n                               tid, d_req, iter, tA.size(), path.size());\n                        fflush(stdout);\n                        if (d_req > best_sol_clr) {\n                            best_sol_clr = d_req;\n                            best_path = path;\n                            if (d_req >= 0.016f) found_high_clr.store(true);\n                        }\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                int cur2 = nearest_node(tree2, target_p, target_q);\n                for (int step = 0; Optimizing & shortcutting...\\n\",\n           best_path.size(), best_sol_clr);\n\n    // Truncate tail as soon as clearance >= 0.47 m!\n    for (size_t i = 1; i < best_path.size(); ++i) {\n        if (eval_clearance(best_path[i].first, best_path[i].second, 0.47f, true) >= 0.47f) {\n            best_path.resize(i + 1);\n            printf(\"Truncated goal tail to %zu nodes (end clearance=%.4f m)\\n\",\n                   best_path.size(), eval_clearance(best_path.back().first, best_path.back().second, -10.0f));\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Subdivide any segment exceeding rig limits (0.094 m, 0.180 rad) first\n    auto discretize_segment = [](const Vec3& a_p, const Quat& a_q, const Vec3& b_p, const Quat& b_q) {\n        float lin = norm(b_p - a_p);\n        float ang = q_angle(a_q, b_q);\n        int n = std::max({1, (int)ceilf(lin / 0.092f), (int)ceilf(ang / 0.178f)});\n        std::vector<std::pair<Vec3, Quat>> seg;\n        seg.reserve(n);\n        for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {\n            float t = (float)k / (float)n;\n            seg.push_back({a_p + (b_p - a_p) * t, q_slerp(a_q, b_q, t)});\n        }\n        return seg;\n    };\n\n    std::vector<std::pair<Vec3, Quat>> path;\n    path.push_back(best_path[0]);\n    for (size_t i = 0;
